rules.statement: A valid fideicommissum must contain a provision that after a specified time or the fulfillment of some condition, the property should go over to the fidei-commissary.
rules.supporting_quote: "What the law requires is that a valid fideicommissum must contain a provision that after a specified time or the fulfilment of some condition the property should go over to the fidei-commissary ; that requirement is satisfied in this case."
